Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 29

“Others, devoted to breath control, offer the outgoing breath into the incoming, and the incoming into the outgoing, restraining the flow of both.”

Even breathing is enlisted. Krishna presents pranayama as a sacrifice like any other, quietly placing the most technical practice on a level with the simplest ones.
